environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 instance with IAM instance profile 'PatientAPI-Role'. The role has a broad DynamoDB policy: Effect=Allow, Action=[dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:PutItem], Resource=arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:123456789012:table/PatientRecords. No condition keys are attached. JWT authentication verifies the user is a valid healthcare provider but the application does not check whether the authenticated provider is authorized to access the specific patient_id in the URL.

config.runtime: EC2 t3.medium, Amazon Linux 2, Django 4.2, DRF 3.14
config.network: Public ALB -> EC2, no additional filtering
